events.title: Demo 1.1.8 Update
events.summary: Information about Casual Mode is now shown when launching the game for the first time.Casual Mode scores can now be submitted to the leaderboard and are ranked separately from Normal Mode.You can switch between Normal Mode and Casual Mode records using the Casual Mode toggle on the leaderboard.Fixed an issue where the hours were not displayed on the World Clear screen when the completion time exceeded one hour.

events.title: Demo 1.1.7 Update
events.summary: The number of checkpoints in Casual Mode has been changed to 3.The number of remaining checkpoints is now displayed.Rank requirements have been slightly adjusted.Achievements have been added. The demo version includes a total of 12 achievements.

events.title: Demo 1.1.6 Update
events.summary: Added a feature that displays color inputs on screen. (Can be disabled in Settings)Adjusted the frame rate options.Added a V-Sync option to Settings, and some options have been moved to different tabs.

events.title: Demo 1.1.5 Update
events.summary: Added background music during gameplay.Lowered the default volume.

events.title: Demo 1.1.4 Update
events.summary: • Some stage maps have been changed, and the rank requirements have been adjusted accordingly.• Added Casual Mode.• Fixed several bugs. - Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when pressing the restart button before or after dying in Stage Practice Mode. - Fixed an issue where records were reset when continuing from Stage 1 of each world during world progression.

events.title: Demo 1.1.3 Update
events.summary: • Fixed an issue where records were not reset when continuing to the next world after clearing a world. • The overall game speed has been reduced, and the rank requirements have been adjusted accordingly.

events.title: Demo 1.1.2 Update
events.summary: • Character corner correction has been adjusted. - The correction logic now triggers only when the top of the character's head hits the ceiling, nudging the character to the left or right. • Fixed an issue where the camera stuttered momentarily upon landing while the character was moving horizontally.

events.title: Demo 1.1.1 Update
events.summary: • The character's acceleration on the ground and in the air has been slightly decreased. • The corner correction logic, which adjusts the character's movement when bumping into corners, has been modified. • The camera movement has been slightly adjusted.

events.title: Demo 1.1.0 Update
events.summary: • The hitbox for spikes has been adjusted, and the layout of certain map structures has been slightly modified as a result. (We have minimized instances where players can stand on the edge of spikes near cliffs.) • The text and layout for certain stages featuring tutorial dialogue have been adjusted. • Fixed an issue where the character appeared to float above the map under specific conditions.

events.title: Demo 1.0.8 Update
events.summary: • Added corner correction — you'll now smoothly slip past the edges of structures even if you clip them by a few pixels while jumping or moving. • Darkened the default color (gray) to make structures easier to tell apart by color. • Improved spike collision — making deep contact with a spike now results in instant death. • Fixed a crash that occurred on some PCs when switching display modes. • Improved capture compatibility with streaming/recording software (OBS, Discord). • Made the character's

events.title: Demo 1.0.8 Update
events.summary: • Adjusted coyote time (jump leniency at platform edges) and jump buffer (early input window). • Improved visibility of energy pads. • Fixed an issue where double jump orbs would occasionally respawn too quickly.
